title: Native fresh-ledger retrieval manifest and installation observation
description: Closed manifest/v2 and Installed/v2 forms, following the existing combined v1 schema pattern. The manifest requires an exact canonical production proof scope/v2 and no objects. The installed result observes an actual empty root:root0555 directory, not fs-verity files, genesis, receipts, signature authority or service readiness. Runtime canonical decoding, independent pins and filesystem checks remain mandatory; neither form admits a native service.

proofScopeOriginalBase64url.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exact serverware.policyShadowProductionCustodyProofScope/v2 original; decoded scope and its framed binding are validated by the consumer.
